verdict.rationale: Render is a cloud application platform, so multi-protocol serving is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack never mentions HTTP, TCP, gRPC, or WebSocket support, let alone serving all four from one service without per-protocol configuration. The private-service and custom-domain mentions are adjacent networking features and earn no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can serve HTTP, TCP, gRPC, and WebSocket traffic from the same deployed service without separate protocol configuration
